title: Get started with Lynch
text: lynch_palette() returns palette name. Printing draws colours.  Ask fewer colours n. Discrete palettes five colours, n can five.  Sequential diverging ramps interpolated, give number colours.   result keeps palette class printing. Use unclass() want plain character vector.
code: lynch_palette("twin_peaks") lynch_palette("blue_velvet", 3) lynch_palette("dune", 12, type = "sequential") lynch_palette("mulholland_drive", type = "diverging") unclass(lynch_palette("wild_at_heart")) #> [1] "#CD5C90" "#E5BF5C" "#771637" "#A5905F" "#515767" #> attr(,"name") #> [1] "wild_at_heart"

title: Get started with Lynch
text: six film palettes five colour-blind-safe versions. Use scale_colour_lynch_d() scale_fill_lynch_d() categories.  Reverse order direction = -1. data categories palette colours, extra levels drawn NA get warning.
code: names(lynch_palettes) #> [1] "blue_velvet"      "dune"             "lost_highway"     "mulholland_drive" #> [5] "twin_peaks"       "wild_at_heart"    "blue_velvet_safe" ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = drv)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_lynch_d("lost_highway") +   theme_minimal()

title: Get started with Lynch
text: Every film palette keeps colours distinct red-green colour blindness except blue_velvet. blue_velvet_safe keeps four colours . lynch_accessibility test results. palette blue_velvet works five groups. Blue Velvet, use blue_velvet_safe four groups fewer.
code: lynch_accessibility[, c("palette", "n_colours", "deutan", "protan", "rating")] #>            palette n_colours deutan protan                     rating #> 1      blue_velvet         5    8.5    6.7 close pair for all viewers #> 2             dune         5   11.2   11.2          colour-blind safe #> 3     lost_highway         5   15.1   13.2          colour-blind safe #> 4 mulholland_drive         5    9.6    8.8          colour-blind safe #> 5       twin_peaks         5    8.2    8.8          colour-blind safe #> 6    wild_at_heart         5    8.1   10.8          colour-blind safe #> 7 blue_velvet_safe         4   17.2   18.1          colour-blind safe ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   scale_colour_lynch_d("twin_peaks", name = "Cylinders") +   theme_minimal()

title: Get started with Lynch
text: scale_colour_lynch_c() scale_fill_lynch_c() map numbers ramp. default sequential.  values either side reference point, use type = "diverging" set midpoint. Without midpoint, grey centre sits halfway across data range.  four films diverging ramps:
code: ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_raster() +   scale_fill_lynch_c("dune") +   theme_minimal() df <- data.frame(   year = 2001:2020,   change = c(-4, -3, -3, -1, 0, 1, -2, 2, 3, 1, 4, 5, 3, 6, 8, 7, 9, 12, 10, 14) )  ggplot(df, aes(year, change, fill = change)) +   geom_col() +   scale_fill_lynch_c("mulholland_drive", type = "diverging", midpoint = 0) +   theme_minimal() names(lynch_diverging) #> [1] "blue_velvet"      "mulholland_drive" "twin_peaks"       "wild_at_heart"

title: Lynch scales for ggplot2 — scale_colour_lynch_d
text: palette Name palette. discrete scales, name names(lynch_palettes). blue_velvet stay distinct red-green colour blindness; use blue_velvet_safe film. continuous scales, name names(lynch_sequential) names(lynch_diverging), depending type. direction 1 palette's order, -1 reverse . ... arguments passed ggplot2::discrete_scale() ggplot2::continuous_scale(), name, labels na.value. type "sequential" ordered values, "diverging" values either side midpoint. midpoint continuous scales, data value put centre ramp, 0 diverging scale. NULL spans data range. guide continuous scales, legend: "colourbar" (default), "legend" "none".

title: Lynch (development version)
text: Four palettes now colour-blind safe , small changes one two colours : dune (#8C7573 #826054), mulholland_drive (#907978 #997B66), twin_peaks (#47A54E #009667) wild_at_heart (#73364F #771637, #9F8A5A #A5905F, diverging ramp match). _safe versions deprecated now return full palette warning. blue_velvet_safe stays. print() palette cleaner look, gaps swatches hex codes underneath, returns palette invisibly. scale_colour_lynch_c() scale_fill_lynch_c() take guide argument. Passing guide used fail “matched multiple actual arguments”. New vignette, vignette("Lynch"), package help page, ?Lynch. examples help pages.

title: Lynch 0.4.0
text: New ggplot2 scales: scale_colour_lynch_d() scale_fill_lynch_d() categories, scale_colour_lynch_c() scale_fill_lynch_c() numbers, sequential diverging ramps optional midpoint. scale_color_* aliases included.

title: Lynch 0.3.0
text: Colour-blind-safe variants five palettes: blue_velvet_safe, dune_safe, mulholland_drive_safe, twin_peaks_safe wild_at_heart_safe. keeps three four colours film’s palette stay distinct red-green colour blindness. lost_highway already passes . New sequential ramps (lynch_sequential, one per film) diverging ramps (lynch_diverging, four films). lynch_palette() gains type = "sequential" type = "diverging" interpolates ramps n. New lynch_accessibility: colour-blindness test results every discrete palette.
